summary: Renames the order detail view from order_detail to show_order. The view now loads only the number and total_cents fields of the order.

findings.title: Renamed view breaks the URL configuration
findings.problem: The change renames order_detail to show_order. The orders/urls.py file still references views.order_detail on line 8.
findings.consequence: Django raises AttributeError when it imports the orders URLconf. Every route fails to load, including the order list and order detail pages.
findings.fix: Keep the name order_detail for the view. Alternatively, update orders/urls.py line 8 to use views.show_order.
